estimate.damage_summary: An atmospheric overvoltage damaged the speaker system and TV connected to the building’s electrical installation. The description and photos support damage to both; no surge-protective device was in use.
estimate.policy_notes: Clauses 2.3.3 and 4.2.4 cover physically damaged electrical appliances from the surge, subject to the EUR 5,000 VAT-inclusive aggregate sub-limit and the pre-loss-standard restriction in 7.1.9. Because the appliances were not connected through a surge-protective device, 2.3.3 halves the otherwise payable amount. Clause 7.1.8(e) excludes the contractor’s own diagnostics and reports; 7.1.8(d) excludes a call-out on an invoice with no indemnifiable work. No deductible is specified in the supplied material.

lines.invoice_text: Surge-damaged home electronics (speaker system and TV set)
lines.rationale: Clauses 2.3.3 and 4.2.4 cover the two physically damaged appliances, subject to the EUR 5,000 VAT-inclusive appliance sub-limit; 7.1.9 limits replacement to standard-grade equivalents of the pre-loss equipment. The described damage and photos support two appliances, but their models and specifications are unknown, so the reasonable unit-price range is broad; the established absence of surge protection under 2.3.3 halves the otherwise payable amount.

lines.invoice_text: Diagnostic surge-failure report and technician call-out
lines.rationale: Although the diagnosis and safety check relate to the reported surge, clause 7.1.8(e) excludes the contractor’s own diagnostics and reports, and 7.1.8(d) excludes a call-out where the same invoice contains no indemnifiable work. The invoice bundles only these non-indemnifiable heads, so 7.1.10 does not support payment; the singular attendance described supports at most one unit, and the estimated unit prices are hypothetical because the line is excluded.
